notes: WI-14 implemented: GET /api/v1/admin/geo-usage (SuperAdminOnly, EndpointWithoutRequest, cross-tenant). Key decisions: (1) Endpoint class named GetAdminGeoUsageEndpoint (not GetGeoUsageEndpoint) to avoid duplicate name conflict with Features/Settings/GetGeoUsage/GetGeoUsageEndpoint — FastEndpoints requires globally unique endpoint names. (2) Used DateOnly month window (monthStart/nextMonthStart) directly for GeoUsage.Day filtering — no UTC conversion needed as Day is already Prague-local. (3) Zero-usage fleets appear in the list by joining active fleets then looking up usage from a dictionary (missing key = 0). (4) Budget retrieved via IgnoreQueryFilters() on FleetSettings with (int?) cast to avoid 0-default trap for missing settings rows. (5) Plain LINQ GroupBy(u => u.FleetId) translates correctly — no raw SQL needed, no MAX(uuid) trap. FakeTimeProvider pinned to 2026-09-10 12:00 UTC; September 2026 is the current month for tests. allowlist + docs/api.md updated and staged.
